summary: A Solana wallet running automated trading bots was drained after unauthorized setAuthority transactions reassigned token account control and transferred SOL to attacker addresses. The victim identified plaintext private key exposure on a VPS and suspicious tPEG swap activity before the drain.
user_mistake: Stored a private key in an exposed shell environment on a VPS
prevention: Store private keys only in restricted permission environment files/Use isolated low balance hot wallets for automated trading bots
